name: hindsight-free-ndx-2016
description: RESEARCH ONLY — never traded. The ~29 largest NASDAQ-100 names as of mid-2016, fixed BEFORE any result was seen (2026-10 profitability review), so a backtest on it can't inherit the 'picked what already went up' bias of config/universe.json. Later delistings (e.g. WBA, CELG) can't be fetched — residual survivorship that favours any strategy, so a fail here is conservative. Default strategy for every symbol (no per-symbol overrides). Use with: bonito research benchmark -u config/research/hindsight_free_2016.json --ingest
